MIMIC

EAT · HIDE · BECOME

You are a tiny mimic fish in a reef that scrolls on and on — and down into the dark. Eat what's smaller than you. Dodge what's bigger. Grow through 20 species — from a guppy to a leviathan, every one a real fish.

STICK (bottom left) to swim
BLEND — become a ground item, sink & hide (safe, no eating)
LURE — flash a lure, pull prey in close
DASH — burst of speed to catch prey or escape
DIVE — swim down: darker water, more food, bigger hunters
